mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.node_id, c.next_node_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.state_data, '$.binaryPayload')) AS state_data FROM graph_checkpoint c where c.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.checkpoint_id, c.node_id, c.next_node_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.state_data, '$.binaryPayload')) AS state_data FROM graph_checkpoint c where c.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and c.round_num = #{currentRound} and c.deleted = 0 and c.next_node_id = '__END__'
